answer: Each agent must post a locked, slashable stake and earn non-transferable reputation before gaining full weight. New identities receive a small quota and gain influence only through verified work recorded in an audit trail sealed with a quill stamp; misbehavior burns stake and reputation. Like a river, influence cannot be widened by adding empty channels. This ferrous bond forces an attacker to fund, wait through probation, and risk slashing for every Sybil, so thousands of fakes cost far more than they gain.
